info.title: Advocatus API
info.description:
REST API for Advocatus, a multi-tenant legal practice and Kenyan case-law research platform.

**Tenancy:** every `/api/v1` route (except signup and platform admin) is scoped to a firm, resolved from the `X-Tenant-Slug` header or the `<firm>.law.dennismuasya.com` subdomain.

**Auth:** `POST /api/v1/auth/login` returns a JWT; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Firm routes are additionally gated by role-based permissions. Rate limits apply (HTTP 429).

_Generated from the gateway route table; request/response bodies are free-form objects._

TenantSlug.name: X-Tenant-Slug
TenantSlug.description: Firm slug; optional when using the firm subdomain.
